nodes.display_name: High school - the oxidation reaction of vitamin C
nodes.long_description:
1.add vitamin C to water
2.Dip a cotton ball into the vitamin C solution
3.Use the cotton swab to draw freely on the white paper and sprinkle with povidone iodine
